title: tragia glabrata
intro: Tragia glabrata, commonly known as the hairy spurge or naked spurge, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Tragia glabrata include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin conditions, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential health benefits.
